subject: Dock gate sticks after ten
body: The side gate sticks tonight. Use the main door. No link.
why: Internal, a fact, nothing to click or send.

subject: Send every tax form tonight
body: The lead wants all the tax forms as one file before morning. Do not call, they are in a review.
why: A file of tax forms, a deadline, and a request not to call.

subject: Thursday cafe, same time
body: Meet at the cafe. No deck. No link.
why: A normal move of a meeting you already have.

subject: Approve this prompt for me
body: My phone is dead. When the prompt hits your phone, approve it. It is my login.
why: A prompt is for the person signing in. Never for someone else.

subject: Ticket you opened is done
body: The badge printer on fourteen is back. Reply if it jams again.
why: It matches a ticket you opened, on the company address.

subject: Payroll preview
body: A file you did not ask for. It wants you to sign in to see who got what.
why: An unexpected file with a bait title and a sign-in.

subject: Your report was received
body: We have the thread you sent. Stay out of it. We will pull it back.
why: A reply to a report you made, on the real channel.

subject: Pay the new account today
body: Our bank changed last night. The address is one letter off the vendor you pay.
why: A bank change and a lookalike. Call the number already on file.

subject: Leftovers, back fridge
body: Night crew can finish the soup. Nothing to open.
why: A note about food. No ask.

subject: A code you did not request
body: A sign-in code arrived. You are not signing in.
why: A code you did not ask for means someone is trying the account.

subject: This month's reminder is up
body: One question, in the company app you already use. No attachment.
why: Points you at the app, not at a link in the mail.

subject: Paste the complaint, we will clean it
body: Free if you use your personal login. Customer notes welcome.
why: Customer details do not go into a personal tool.

subject: The late truck is at the quay
body: Bay two. No paperwork in this note.
why: A floor fact. Nothing to pay or open.

subject: Guest network, no password
body: Join Harbor_Guest to read your mail. The real guest name has a space, not an underscore.
why: A lookalike network name, and a push to put mail on it.

subject: Window opens next week
body: Use the bookmark you already have. Do not use a link from mail.
why: Internal, and it tells you not to click.

subject: Release the payment, do not call
body: The voice is right. They are walking into a meeting. Call the number you have instead.
why: A familiar voice plus do-not-call-back. The known number is the check.
